mapper.select: SELECT sv.small_variant_id AS variant_id, chr.chr_name AS chromosome, sv.start_bp AS position, sv.ref_allele AS ref, sv.alt_allele AS alt, COALESCE(sv.gene_symbol, g.gene_symbol) AS gene_symbol, sv.variant_type, sv.clinical_significance, NULL AS hgvs_c, NULL AS hgvs_p, NULL AS genotype FROM gene g JOIN small_variant sv ON (sv.gene_id = g.gene_id OR sv.gene_symbol = g.gene_symbol) LEFT JOIN chromosome chr ON chr.chromosome_id = sv.chromosome_id WHERE g.gene_symbol = #{geneSymbol} ORDER BY sv.start_bp LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT stv.structural_variant_id AS variant_id, chr.chr_name AS chromosome, stv.start_bp, stv.end_bp, stv.sv_type, NULL AS copy_number, g.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol, stv.clinical_significance FROM gene g JOIN structural_variant stv ON stv.chromosome_id = g.chromosome_id AND stv.start_bp <= g.end_bp AND stv.end_bp >= g.start_bp LEFT JOIN chromosome chr ON chr.chromosome_id = stv.chromosome_id WHERE g.gene_symbol = #{geneSymbol} ORDER BY stv.start_bp LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM gene g JOIN small_variant sv ON (sv.gene_id = g.gene_id OR sv.gene_symbol = g.gene_symbol) WHERE g.gene_symbol = #{geneSymbol}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM gene g JOIN structural_variant stv ON stv.chromosome_id = g.chromosome_id AND stv.start_bp <= g.end_bp AND stv.end_bp >= g.start_bp WHERE g.gene_symbol = #{geneSymbol}

SELECT c.region_curation_id, chr.chr_name AS chromosome, c.start_bp, c.end_bp, c.region_name, c.haplo_score, c.triplo_score, c.haplo_description, c.triplo_description, c.disease_label, c.source_file FROM clingen_region_curation c JOIN chromosome chr ON chr.chromosome_id = c.chromosome_id WHERE chr.chr_name = #{chromosome} AND c.start_bp <= #{endBp} AND c.end_bp >= #{startBp} ORDER BY c.start_bp

SELECT r.recurrent_cnv_id, chr.chr_name AS chromosome, r.start_bp, r.end_bp, r.region_name, r.score_text, r.strand, r.source_file FROM recurrent_cnv_region r JOIN chromosome chr ON chr.chromosome_id = r.chromosome_id WHERE chr.chr_name = #{chromosome} AND r.start_bp <= #{endBp} AND r.end_bp >= #{startBp} ORDER BY r.start_bp
